name: liquid-taffy-engine
title: Liquid Taffy Engine
description: The shared engine of the liquid surfaces: a timeline on Motion's frame loop, the spring curves, the goo filter settings, the seam light, the grab-and-stretch gesture, the frame (light or dark) and an optional synthesized voice.
label: liquid-taffy
author: arknow91 <https://github.com/arknow91>

props.name: taffyTimeline / taffyTo / taffySet
props.description: The tween timeline (positions in seconds, `overwrite: "auto"`, `autoAlpha`, transforms around an origin, named, bezier and sampled eases), written on Motion's frame loop.

props.name: HOUSE_SPRING / POP_SPRING
props.description: The two sampled spring curves the surfaces move on: a settled house spring and a springier pop.

props.name: setGooBlur / GOO_RIM_THRESHOLDS
props.description: The goo filter: one blur and one pair of rim thresholds, solved together so the 1px border keeps its weight at every blur.

props.name: createLiquidSeam / createLiquidStretch
props.description: The seam light between two touching bodies, and the press-and-drag gesture that pulls a liquid finger out of an edge and snaps it back.

props.name: useLiquidFrame / LiquidThemeProvider
props.description: The frame a surface stands on: its own `theme`, else the provider's, else the page (a `.dark` ancestor).

props.name: gooSfx
props.description: The synthesized voice (Web Audio, no samples). It plays only inside a user gesture and never on its own; `mute()` and `volume(0..1)` control it.

a11y: The engine draws only; the surfaces that use it own the roles, names and keyboard behaviour.
Motion is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion (`prefersReducedMotion()`), and sound plays only after a user gesture.
